## QRSalt — scan trigger test

1. Make the **QRSalt API** credential first and call it **QRSalt account**, then open the **QRSalt Trigger** node and check the Credential field is filled in. If it is empty, pick it.
2. **Switch the workflow on** (top right). That is what registers the webhook with QRSalt — a manual execution does not register it.
3. QRSalt has to be able to reach this n8n from the internet. On a laptop, start n8n with `n8n start --tunnel` (or put it behind a public URL) or the subscription is refused — the node says so in the error.
4. Now run **zzz-full-test**: it requests the short link it creates, which is a real scan, and QRSalt delivers `scan.recorded` here. Or open any live short link of yours.
5. Open the latest execution and copy the single `report` field from **Scan Received**. The first line is the verdict: it says PASSED only when a delivery arrived carrying a scan, and names what is missing otherwise.

Switching the workflow off again deletes the webhook endpoint from your workspace.
